Name: Shane's New Job
Author: ranfuu
Description:
[b]FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changes Shane’s schedule post-Joja:
After seeing the community center event and saying bye to JojaMart, he will start working at the saloon instead of staying home at Marnie’s[*]New work animations
[*]Removes sad jobless dialogue
[/list]
This only works when Shane is unmarried [i]and[/i] Joja is gone.

[b]REQUIREMENTS:
[/b]- SMAPI
- Content Patcher

[b]INSTALL:
[/b]- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download and unzip files
- Place folder in “\Stardew Valley\Mods”
- Run game with SMAPI
